title: Your first attribute: a customer training note
goal: Add one optional string attribute to Клиенты and save the description while understanding the database-update boundary.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Add an attribute rather than a tabular section.
Distinguish technical name, synonym, String type and length 80.
Save development without mistaking it for a verified stored item value.
sections: The note describes one customer independently of requests, so it belongs to a Клиенты item. Putting it in a document would give separate notes to that customer’s different requests. That can be another valid need, but is not ours. Do not create another customer entity for one field.

In the prepared structure Клиенты has no custom attributes; Код and Наименование are standard properties. Use Add in Реквизиты rather than Табличные части. A tabular section stores multiple rows inside one object and is excessive here.
A technical name and readable synonym

Use the technical name УчебнаяЗаметка without spaces. Its synonym Учебная заметка is displayed in the form. The platform may derive the synonym automatically when you leave the name field; still verify it. A synonym change does not alter the purpose or type of stored values.

If the attribute exists from an earlier attempt, inspect and reuse it instead of adding УчебнаяЗаметка1. Prior work and attempt history matter more than matching an illustration. Resolve a different meaning behind an identical name before proceeding.
A string holds text with chosen limits

Choose Строка and length 80. This stores short text, not a calculation, customer reference or secret. Variable length permits short notes while the maximum bounds input. Leave unlimited length disabled. Check the new attribute’s right-hand Длина, not the standard Наименование length in the central editor.

Choose limits from need and boundary examples. Plan empty, ordinary, exactly 80-character and over-limit inputs. Do not promise a specific over-limit message: a form may constrain input before writing. Observe actual behavior and compare the persisted length.
An empty initial value preserves existing meaning

Earlier items initially have empty notes until filled. The attribute is optional, so this update does not require rewriting every old customer. An empty note does not mean a missing name, code or reference. Mandatory input and default filling are separate rules introduced deliberately.

Close the object editor and save the configuration. This saves the development description. Database configuration may still differ, with its update command available and a difference marker at the tree. Next inspect and apply that update, then test the form and persistence. A tree node does not prove a saved Enterprise note.

lab.title: Describe one short optional note
lab.environment: Official installed 1C, prepared copy only; no code or Studio.
steps: Choose Моя служба — изменения, open configuration, expand Справочники and double-click Клиенты, then select Данные.
Check for УчебнаяЗаметка. If absent select Реквизиты and use its upper green plus. If present from your attempt, inspect it.
Enter УчебнаяЗаметка in Имя and leave the field. Verify Учебная заметка in Синоним. Do not rename Клиенты itself.
Set Тип Строка, Длина 80 and variable length. Leave unlimited length disabled and filling validation at Не проверять. Leave the edited field to apply.
Close the catalog editor, save with Ctrl+S and verify УчебнаяЗаметка remains while database update is available.
expected: Реквизиты and standard code/name properties are visible.
The attribute’s property palette opens on the right.
The attribute appears in the tree with its readable synonym.
The attribute is saved; form and value tests follow next.
evidence: Copy identity and the attribute’s name, synonym, type, length and optionality.
Explicit state: development saved; applying and persisting a value are not yet claimed verified.
lab.negative: A repeated attempt reuses the existing field without a duplicate.

mistakes: The customer name length is edited instead of the new attribute’s length.
Select УчебнаяЗаметка and inspect its right-hand property palette.
A tabular section is added to store one customer text.
Use the catalog’s own Реквизиты section.
A tree node is treated as proof of a stored value.
Apply the database update and test writing/rereading in the next lesson.
